MOD = 1000000007

def main():
    p, k = map(int, input().split())
    result_value = 1

    if k == 0:
        for i in range(1, p):
            result_value = (result_value * p) % MOD
        print(result_value)
        return

    if k == 1:
        for i in range(p):
            result_value = (result_value * p) % MOD
        print(result_value)
        return

    power_cache = [1] * (p + 1)
    for i in range(1, p + 1):
        power_cache[i] = (power_cache[i - 1] * k) % p

    seen = [False] * p
    for i in range(1, p):
        if not seen[i]:
            j = i
            length = 0
            while True:
                seen[j] = True
                length += 1
                j = (k * j) % p
                if seen[j]:
                    break
            if power_cache[length] == 1:
                result_value = (result_value * p) % MOD

    print(result_value)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
